source: RBE · Revolution By Education — 50 Days Daily Targets PDF

phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Maths topic-wise (Arithmetic → Algebra/Trigonometry), sectionals of all four subjects, Computer basics

phases.name: Speed & Accuracy
phases.focus: Geometry, Mensuration, DI, Statistics; full mocks in exam timing; weak-section sectionals

phases.name: Final Revision
phases.focus: Rev-3 of wrong and unattempted questions, Computer PYQs, final full mocks

revision_method.rev1: Same day: re-solve wrong and unattempted questions without seeing solutions; note tricks/formulas.
revision_method.rev2: Coming Sunday: re-solve wrong and unattempted questions from all tests of that week.
revision_method.rev3: Days 46–50: final revision of leftover mistakes in blocks Days 1–9, 10–18, 19–27, 28–36, 37–45, plus all full-mock mistakes.

daily_workflow: Attempt full mock at exam timing when assigned
Analyse answers immediately after each test
Re-solve wrong and unattempted questions without viewing solutions (Rev-1)
Record formulas, traps and recurring errors in a mistake notebook
Computer practice daily; keep it qualifying-ready
plan_usage.weekly_review: On the designated Sunday, re-solve wrong and unattempted questions from the preceding six days (Rev-2).
plan_usage.final_review: Days 46–50: Rev-3 in blocks Days 1–9, 10–18, 19–27, 28–36 and 37–45, plus all full-mock errors.
plan_usage.workload_note: The source PDF assigns multiple tests on many days. Split into 4–5 sessions; do not sacrifice analysis to increase attempts.
